cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've signed 'take care' like you. A proper ending. That's how my last breakup started.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you had a cold. I meant get better.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, recovery first. He wanted me healthy before he left too. Less guilt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?

reason: Tie mistaken imitation to the actual hopeful redirect, outward comfort, reciprocal-risk bargain, bounded vulnerability, or feared ending; keep material partner contributions and natural requests.
